# FG-REVIEW-0004

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 422 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `an_inline_discussion_outside_the_diff_is_refused` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: コメントの位置がこの版の差分にありません。差分を表示し直して、変更された行を選んでください。
- en: The comment's position is not in this version's diff. Reload the diff and choose a changed line.
- id: Posisi komentar tidak ada dalam diff versi ini. Muat ulang diff dan pilih baris yang berubah.

## 原因 (cause)

An inline discussion was to be started (`POST /api/v1/projects/{id}/merge-requests/{iid}/discussions` with a `position`) on a place that is not in the named version's diff (`merge_base_sha..head_sha`, ADR-0024 R2): reason=version_unknown (the merge request has no such version), version_purged (its refs were removed, secret removal), version_base_pending (the version job has not recorded its bases yet), path_not_in_diff (no file of the diff has that path on that side), diff_truncated (the path is not among the files listed and the diff was cut by a cap, so it cannot be shown to be there), no_patch (the file is binary or its patch was left out by a size cap: it has no lines to comment on) or line_out_of_range (the line is in no hunk of the file on that side). Nothing was written.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `reason`, `project_id`, `iid`, `version`, `side` and `line` (never the path or the body). List the versions (`gstn mr versions IID --project ID`) and show the version's diff (`gstn mr diff IID --project ID --version N --patch`): the hunk headers `@@ -a,b +c,d @@` give the commentable lines (old side a..a+b-1, new side c..c+d-1).

## 対処 (fix)

Start the discussion on a line inside a hunk of a listed file of an existing, unpurged version (or start a general discussion without a position).
